thread:
marta: pushed a new set of quant profiles i'm calling 'sashimi' for marlin-70b across us-west1 (A100), us-east1 (H100), and eu-central1 (H100). main goals: 1) get speedups per-gpu for FP16/BF16/INT8/FP8, 2) measure quality deltas on the smoke eval set, 3) surface kernel choices that regressed latency in eu.
raj: nice. did you run the small prompt bank or the full inference sweep?
sylvia: small prompt bank (~2.5k prompts) + 4 concurrency levels (1/4/8/16). we captured p50/p95/p99 latency and token/s throughput. attaching quick notes and a perf-bot summary link: https://perf/reports/sashimi/1938765432
marta: thanks. top-line numbers?
perf-bot: ```
SUMMARY sashimi 1938765432
Model: marlin-70b
Regions: us-west1(A100), us-east1(H100), eu-central1(H100)
Profiles: FP16, BF16, INT8, FP8
p50 latency (1c): us-west FP16=95ms BF16=97ms INT8=74ms FP8=68ms
p95 latency (1c): us-west FP16=280ms BF16=290ms INT8=210ms FP8=185ms
throughput (tokens/s, 16c): us-west FP16=12.3k BF16=12.1k INT8=18.9k FP8=21.5k
quality delta (avg embedding sim vs fp16 baseline): BF16=+0.0%, INT8=-0.6%, FP8=-0.9%
Note: eu-central p95 for INT8 shows ~12% tail jitter vs us-east; kernel fallback observed on h100 driver 2.1
```
raj: FP8 looks great for cost+latency, small quality hit but maybe acceptable for chat-like workloads. INT8 is middle ground.
kevin: i dug into eu-central regression — kernel choice was an experimental amx-fusion kernel we enabled for INT8; on some H100 microcode combos it falls back to a slower path at high seq lengths.
sylvia: repro snippet: ```bash
# run target workload
python benchmarks/run.py --model marlin-70b --profile int8 --region eu-central1 --seq 2048 --concurrency 8
``` 
infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-1294: investigate h100 microcode/kernel mismatch for amx-fusion fallback (linked to perf report)
marta: good catch. For capacity sizing: based on 16-concurrency throughput numbers we estimate one A100 node (8x A100 GPU pool) handles ~150k tokens/s with FP16, ~260k with FP8. For SLAs we usually multiply by 0.7 safety factor.
raj: so that implies ~1.2M tokens/s per 8-gpu pool with FP8 after safety factor? check math pls.
kevin: quick calc: 21.5k tok/s per GPU * 8 = 172k tok/s raw -> *0.7 = 120k tok/s per node. maybe you had a different concurrency mix.
sylvia: we observed cross-region variance: eu p95 can be 8-12% worse under bursty traffic; recommend reserving an extra 10% capacity or using routing policy to prefer us-east for low-latency tiers.
marta: decision proposals:
- default serving profile: FP16 for high-quality endpoints (search, synthesis)
- latency-optimized tier: FP8 with monitored quality regressions and automatic rollback if embedding sim drops >1.5% on eval set
- region-specific override: block experimental amx-fusion INT8 in eu until INFRA-1294 resolved
raj: +1 on region override. also suggest adding a quick eval after deployment that runs 500 prompts and checks embedding drift.
kevin: for kernels: pin to kernel v1 (non-amx) for eu INT8, let us-east continue testing amx-fusion behind a canary flag.
perf-bot: posted detailed CSVs to s3://redwood-perf/sashimi/1938765432/*.csv
marta: action items: (1) infra to triage INFRA-1294 (kevin) (2) eng-ml to add 500 prompt post-deploy eval + rollout guard (raj, sylvia) (3) ops to update routing policy and capacity estimate doc (marta)
raj: i'll add the post-deploy eval harness in this PR: https://git/repo/pulls/482
kevin: starting INFRA-1294 investigation now, will update by EOD.
sylvia: will prepare a small dashboard showing p95 by region/profile; plan to show on next eng-ml sync.
marta: thanks team. next check-in after infra update. :thumbsup:
